Rooms.Name: The Amber Circle
Rooms.Description:
You're are standing outside the Amber Circle's stronghold. On either
side you are flanked by a large tower. On the ground in front of you is a
trench about one human hand deep. The trench has been dug into
the ground, which has been inlaid with mithril. Placed in the mithril is
the Amber, which is so important to the Circle. A translucent barrier of
energy separates you from the interior of the clan house making the
impressive clockwork Minotaur clan guardians pointless. Both obstacles
recognize members of the circle and will let them pass.

Exits.Description: The stronghold of the Amber Circle lies this way.
The Forest lies to the south.

Rooms.Name: Circle of the Blade
Rooms.Description:
In this area the ground has a slight slope and the grass has grown
long. In the center is a wooden platform shaped like a circle with a
series of runes formed from amber. The platform serves as a combat ring
where warriors of the circle test their skills. The platform's real purpose
is a protection circle during summonings. Groups of warriors stand within
the runes and are thus protected. One warrior will stay within the circle
at all times during summonings, chanting hymns meant to restrain the power
of any demons in the amber circle.

Exits.Description: A training lesson for fighters is in sessios.
A clockwork gnome is wandering around announcing bulletins.
A door blocks you from seeing inside the tower of fire.

Rooms.Name: Hear Ye! Hear Ye!
Rooms.Description:
This part of the stronghold's courtyard serves as a meeting ground for
hunting parties. The clan message board, a clockwork gnome, is walking
around calling out any important bulletins. An atm is set into an alcove
in the tower of earth awaiting your banking needs.

Exits.Description: You see an enormous metal bowl resting on a platform.
A runic circle dominates the area to your west.
The world of midgaard lies this way.
You see two warriors practice blade routines within a circle of runes.

Rooms.Name: Circle of Spells
Rooms.Description:
The ground here is grassy and covered in the shade of a tall oak
tree. An amber rune circle was placed here to allow magi and clerics a
chance to practice their craft. The circle has been inscribed on a wood
platform covered by pure gold and inlaid with Amber. It is often used
by young casters practicing their new spells under the watchful eye of
an archmagi or high cleric. During rituals a magi or cleric will sit
here and chant hymns meant to undo any magic a deamon tries to cast.

Exits.Description: A group of spell casters sit here studying their book under the sky.
A door blocks you from seeing inside the tower of earth.
A clockwork gnome is wandering around announcing bulletins.

Rooms.Name: Blade and Bludgeon
Rooms.Description:
This is where many of the warriors practice their attack and defense
routines. The ground is level providing stable footing and the grass has
been trimmed. A few racks on either side of the area hold every type of
weapon imaginable. Some of the warriors are reading books about attack
and defense styles but most are practicing with the weapons instead. The
area smells of sweat, blood, and determination. A small bucket rests on a
nearby table along with a plate of bread, a dish of butter, and a bowl of
jelly. A strange gnomish invention, powered by a small amber mana battery
is turning three oblong, flat, blunt blades. The mechanism keeps the air
moving so the fighters can cool off. Gnomes sure are useful.

Exits.Description: You see a green house used for growing food.
You see an enormous bowl resting on a platform.
You see two warrior fighting within a runic circle.
You see the tower of water.

Rooms.Name: Circle of Binding
Rooms.Description:
This area of the courtyard is probably the most important place within
the stronghold. Five amber rune circles have been placed in small mithril
trenches and all are inscribed with smaller runes of protection. Each is
aligned with a different tower and attuned to one of the elemental
powers. In the center a large mithril bowl sits upon a solid amber
framework. The amber framework pierces the bowl in five places creating
another set of runic circles. A pile of wood rests next to the bowl and
has been prepared with spells so that no daemon may touch it. All these
elements combined create a powerful summoning circle.

Exits.Description: The sights and smells of a feast in preparation great you warmly.
You see the more studious members of the clan hard at work.
A clockwork gnome is wandering around announcing bulletins.
Warriors and rouges are all gathered around practicing blade crafts.

Rooms.Name: Spell and scroll
Rooms.Description:
A few wooden tables rest in this flat grassy area of the courtyard. It
is here, at these tables, that many of the clan's Magi study their craft.
On the table tops are loafs of bread, dishes of butter, jars of jelly,
and pitchers of water.  The area is also spotted with small trees forming
shade to lounge in and maybe even take a nap. Most of the Magi seem to
prefer the tables. You even see one warrior studying a book concerning
the language used to cast spells. It is a very inviting place to sit,
relax, and learn about the arcane arts.

Exits.Description: You see the smithy hard at work creating weapons for the circle.
You see the tower of air.

A group of young magi are practicing their spells under the watch of a
powerful archmage.
The master binding circle lies this direction.

Rooms.Name: The Green House
Rooms.Description:
Everyone needs food to eat. The green house is the circle's solution to
feeding the clan. The green house is a wooden building frame fitted with
an odd green metal. Each piece of metal is inscribed with a rune meant to
aid the growth of the vegetables, and fruits. A fairly large area has
been fenced off and serves as a chicken coop. All the smells mingled
together create a very relaxing aroma. A young girl is planting new
tomato plants and a boy, who looks to be near her age, is walking around
with a pail watering the plants. Together they grow and care for most of
the food used to feed the clan.

Exits.Description: The sights and smells of a feast in preparation great you warmly.
Warriors and rouges are all gathered around practicing blade crafts.

Rooms.Name: Feasting Tables
Rooms.Description:
This is where the clan comes to sit and have meals together. Currently
lunch is being prepared. Bread is being baked in a large stone oven next
to a deer roasting on a spit. A semi-circle of fire hosts five huge pots
full of soup. Vegetable beef, clam chowder,  beef stew, and more are all
simmering in their pots waiting to be eaten. On the dining tables rest
platters of bread, pitchers of milk and water, and great slabs of cheese.
A few members of the clan are already sitting here waiting for the food
to be ready. Eating is a very important affair in the stronghold of the
Amber Circle.

Exits.Description: You see the Tower of Soul.
You see the smithy hard at work.
The Master Binding circle greets you.
You see vines of ivy twined around the greenhouse.

Rooms.Name: The Smithy
Rooms.Description:
To fight daemons you need good weapons and armor to protect you.  An
excellent smith from a local village has agreed to work for the Circle in
return for housing, food, and some spending money. The greatest payment
he receives is the opportunity for his children to read, and learn
from the books the circle possess. The smithy's anvil rests upon a broad
tree trunk. Behind that lies his forge, and a wooden barrel filled with
water stands between the two. Currently the smith is working on a new
breastplate to put in the clan store room.

Exits.Description: You see the more studious members of the clan hard at work.
The sights and smells of a feast in preparation great you warmly.

Rooms.Name: Chambers of Healing
Rooms.Description:
This is the bottom room of the Tower of Soul. It is enchanted with
powerful spells of regeneration to aid healing. Large comfortable couches
line walls; and a fountain of fresh mead lies in the room's center. A
spiral staircase twists its way up to the second floor.

Exits.Description: The sights and smells of a feast in preparation great you warmly.
The library is upstairs.

Rooms.Name: Storage Chamber
Rooms.Description:
This room is the bottom floor of the Tower of Water. It serves as a
storage chamber for the less useful pieces of equipment the clan has come
across. Extra tables, chairs, barrels, clothes, boots, swords, shields,
and many other common, but useful, pieces of equipment are stored here.
All the items are stored away in an organized manner either in cabinets,
on shelves, on tables, or in whatever way works best. A staircase runs
along the wall leading to the second floor.

Exits.Description: You see warriors and rogues practicing their blade craft.

Rooms.Name: Treasurery of Amber
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the Tower of Air. This is the clan's treasure chamber.
Piles of gold litter the floor and pieces of magical equipment lay about
as if they were common items. These are here to be used by anyone in the
clan who might need them. Near the back of the room sit three enormous
oak chests filled with precious amber. The center of the room has a rune
carved into the floor. The rune creates a powerful gust of wind, strong
enough to move you to the second floor through a round opening in the
ceiling. That should be a fun ride.

Exits.Description: You see the more studious members of the Circle hard at work.

Rooms.Name: Chamber of the Blade
Rooms.Description:
Although the Circle promotes a closeness between all its members, no
matter what their race might be, some distinctions are useful. This room,
the bottom room in the Tower of Fire, serves as barracks for the more
combat oriented members of the clan. Magi and clerics need a quiet place
to rest and study their books. Warriors and rogues often stay up far into
the night drinking and playing dice or card games. Though no one is here
right now, a keg of fine dark ale rests in the corner waiting for the
night to come. A bones alley seems to call you and your money with eager
promises of fun. Despite the rooms rowdy nature every bed is neatly made
and more than one has a book of lore resting on top of the sheets. A
stiarcase lining the back wall leads to the second floor.

Exits.Description: You see warriors engaged in sparing matches.

Rooms.Name: Chamber of the Arcane
Rooms.Description:
The bottom floor of the Tower of Earth is the sleeping chamber of the
clan's spell casters but serves. Rows of beds line the walls in neat rows
In a small area at the back of the room a table has been placed for
anyone who wants to study late at night. A staircase lining the back
wall leads too the seond floor.

Exits.Description:
You see young magi practicing their spells under the watchful eye of a
powerful archmage.

Rooms.Name: The Library
Rooms.Description:
Reading and firsthand experience are the quickest ways to learn what
you don't already know. Since firsthand experience can sometimes be very
dangerous, reading is preferred by many. This library is the pinnacle of
what a library is meant to be. Each shelf stands at about the height of
an average troll, and is absolutely stuffed with books of all types. In
the middle of the room is a spiral staircare leading to the different
floors of the tower. Either side of the room hosts innumerable book
shelves. Down the middle of the room is an area with tables instead of
shelves. Surrounding the staircase are several podiums with books of
particular importance to the clan in them. The first is named
"#wMysteries of Amber.#N" The second is titled "#wEncyclopedia  Celestia,#N"
it probably details the different known daemon and  angel orders. The
others are blank.

Exits.Description: The Chamber of Amber is upstrairs.
The Chamber of Healing is downstairs.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The books is opened to a page concerned with the proper incantations for
summoning an imp. You decide to flip through to see if anything catches
you eye. The first things you notice of interest is a picture of a demon
lord being summoned by the Circle. The demon is of a type you don't seem
to remember. A caption at the pages bottle says it is the demon prince
Gratt'z. The oppisite page lists a peculiar occurance at this summoning
that had never occured before. It says that Grattz came into the circle
his own free will to provide the Circle with information about his great
rivals, Orcus, next plot. What made the summoning truly interesting is
that the Amber did not actively restrain Gratt'z as it should have. The
next twenty pages talk about the possible reason for this and the magic
theories behind these ideas. The most notable theory is that since
Gratt'z came into the circle of his own free will that the amber
responded with like action by not restraining him. How interesting...

This book is worn and old though well cared for. It probably been read
through by every member of the order at least once. It is opened to an
entry on a group of Angels known as Star lords. They are rarely seen on
the earthly plane since they are embodiements stars. Its also talks
about a gypsy whose crystal ball can show a person the way to these
beings if she can be found.

Rooms.Name: The Chamber of Amber
Rooms.Description:
This is the Chamber of Amber. In this room the Morphean Oracles and
the High Seers perform the spells of summoning to "extract" information
from extra-planar beings. In the very center of the room is a small amber
circle. Surrounding it are ten more circles big enough for even a
Half-ogre to sit cross-legged comfortably. Every stone in the walls has
a rune carved into it as well. At the walls' base are rugs for other
members of the clan to sit on. Along the walls are sconces, with candles
enchanted to renew their wax. The light cast by the candles seems to
dance along the edges of the amber cirles before being sucked in by the
power of the runes. Numerous doors lead into private rooms of  different
clan members. The northern door is guarded by a stone golem and a
staircase at the room's back leads down into the library.

Exits.Description: This door leads to the Council Room.
This door leads to Darth's private chambers.
This heavy metal door leads to Malcalypse's chambers.
This door leads to Xorinthalasea's private chambers.
The clan library lies this way.

Rooms.Name: The Council Chambers
Rooms.Description:
This is the Council Chambers of the Amber Circle. The room contains a
circular wooden table with a number of chairs around it. Each chair is
distinctly different from the others. In the middle of the table is a
glowing orb, It looks as if words are dancing across its surface. The
walls have torches set in sconces. They flicker eternally, and change
colors, thanks to a magical dweamoner.

Exits.Description: The flicker of candles reveals the Chamber of Amber.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
At what looks to be the head of the table rests two chairs. The first
looks like a hovering #Wbowl#N. It has a very soft cushion in it and
looks very comfy. The second chair is a dragon sized #Wpappasan#N with a
mithril base. Other chairs rest around the table as well.

Rooms.Name: Darth's Chamber
Rooms.Description:
The air in this room is thick with the scent of incense. Candles line
the walls casting a low light on the room's features. The center of the
room is occupied by a low table with cushions laid out in front of them,
which are ideal for kneeling. The table is covered in a plethora of
trinkets and puzzles meant to train the mind & hone perceptions. A pile of
books also rest on the table. A number of object dangle from the walls
and ceiling, just barely illuminated by the candles. You see balls
hanging from chains, hoops on hinges, and lots of other strange devices.
Many of them have ropes tied to them and are set up so they can be moved.
A complex system of pulleys run along the ceiling as well and the ropes
all come together near a series of ten levers. Beneath the levers is a
small metallic monkey with a red button on his forehead. In the corner
you see what can only be Darth's bed. It isn't so much a bed as a pile of
pillows blankets and other soft objects. The room seems to suit its
owner well. The only exit is through an oak door to the west.

Rooms.Name: A Dream of Marble.
Rooms.Description:
Black and white marble intertwine in the room, creating intricate
patterns on the walls, ceiling and floor. Inlaid in the walls are golden
words forming the history of someone that walked the long road of life,
and tried to enjoy every second of it, in both sunshine and rain. An
exquisite goldplated chandelier lights the room. The flames of the
candles make the shadows dance in front of your eyes. The sweet scent of
honeysuckle fills the room as a slight breeze sweeps the dust from an
opened window to the far left. To the right is a very large fireplace. A
wood pile lies to the side of it, ready to be put into the fire to give
Xorinthalasea warmth. On the right is an oversized chair with books
stacked all around, all with tattered covers that shows how lovingly
they had been read through the ages. Two glasses of chardonnay have been
set out on a table next to the chair. One for the host, Xorinthalasea.
The second for you. The words "Welcome" come to your ear on the noon day
breeze.

Rooms.Name: An Ancient Curse
Rooms.Description:
As you enter the lair of Malcalypse you suddenly feel at odds with
your own soul.  All around you it seems as though something is trying to
get into, or perhaps more accurately out of your very being.  The runes
of this room represent the darker side of everyones soul.  Of the few
that catch your eye one seems to represent Chaos and another an ancient
Evil whose name no one dares to speak.  Upon closer inspection the wall
furthest from the door seems to be completely covered in fresh blood.  A
large dark amber circle, big enough for a dragon, hangs in the air with
but a single pillow.  In one corner of the room you notice a treasure
hoard and in another the remains of a bonfire.  Melted candles make a
circle in the center of the room but the summoning circle is unlike any
other in the house.  Why would anyone choose to actually live in this
room?  What is Malcalypse trying to summon into this world?  Or is he
attempting to keep something out?  In the corner is that the remains of
dinner or a blood sacrifice?

Objects.Name: board bulletin order amber circle clockwork gnome
Objects.ShortDescription: an Amber Circle clan bulletin board
Objects.Description: A clockwork gnome is calling out important messages.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board.  Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM#>.

Objects.Name: clockwork minotaurs
Objects.Description: Two massively muscled clockwork minotaurs guard the Amber Circle clanhouse.

Objects.Name: fountain
Objects.Description: A pure white fountain overflows with tasty mead.

Objects.Name: phantom shadowy
Objects.Description: A shadowy phantom blocks the entrance to the council chambers.

Objects.Name: board orb magical
Objects.Description: A small magical orb awaits your command.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: This is a bulletin board. Use LOOK BOARD and READ <ITEM>.

Objects.Name: atm teller bank machine
Objects.Description: An automatic teller machine has been installed in the wall here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is a small note on the machine which says:

To use, type "BALANCE", "WITHDRAW x", or "DEPOSIT x".  Please report any
strange occurrences to the bank manager.
